summary: LAHORE: The Crime Control Department (CCD) claimed on Saturday that the prime suspect in the murder of a bride on her wedding day in Gujranwala district was killed during an alleged exchange of fire. He was initially treated at a private hospital before being transferred to Thrissur Medical College Hospital. Unfortunately, he succumbed to his injuries late Friday night during treatment.
